summary: Nora can find photos and videos people sent in the same chat, by words and by how long ago, and open them by their code even after they have scrolled out of her recent messages.
details: media_search gains a room scope and a days look-back of 1 to 90; media from other chats is never returned, and no sender is named.
A video is found by words from its stored reading.
media_fetch and computer_import now resolve a code against the chat's last 90 days of sent media, not only what is still in view; a code matching two items still asks which one.
A database error while searching her media is now reported as unavailable instead of as an empty result.
limitations: Stickers cannot be told from photos in the record and can appear in room search results.
Voice notes are not part of room search, though a voice note's code still resolves.
Media with no stored reading yet cannot match words and is counted in the answer rather than listed.

A chat with more than 1000 sent media items in 90 days is searched from the newest back; the answer says when older items were not reached, and a code that is not found then is reported as unavailable, not as missing.
